name: R&R BBQ (Draper / South Jordan / Logan) Smoked Turkey Breast, Pulled Pork & Funeral Potatoes
brandOrRestaurant: R&R BBQ (Draper, South Jordan & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Championship Utah BBQ chain offering ultra-lean sliced smoked turkey breast, tender pulled pork, soft white Texas Toast, and creamy mac & cheese or mashed potatoes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Single or Double Meat Plate with Sliced Smoked Turkey Breast (or lean Brisket / Pulled Pork) with BBQ sauce on the side, Texas Toast, and Mac & Cheese or Mashed Potatoes (skipping fried okra and coleslaw).
watchOuts: Use sweet/mild BBQ sauce sparingly and skip the spicy BBQ sauce and raw cabbage slaw
